name: kdif
description: Generate an interactive single-file HTML diff of this KiCad project between git revisions: board layers and schematic sheets overlaid (red = only in A, green = only in B, yellow = unchanged), with a crossfade slider and split view. Runs kicad-cli under the hood and reads the revisions from the project's git repository.

actions.name: kdif
actions.description: Diff this project between git revisions as an interactive HTML file
